# Stage 3 — Prototype

Fill after Stage 2 approval **and** a Unity LTS project exists (created in the Editor).

**Codename:**
**Spec:**
**Date:**

## Exit question

**IS THIS MECHANIC WORTH CONTINUING?**

## Allowed

- [ ] Core gameplay
- [ ] Basic visual feedback / juice
- [ ] Win / lose
- [ ] Restart
- [ ] Rough levels (handful, data-driven if cheap)

## Forbidden (do not build)

- [ ] Store
- [ ] Advanced settings
- [ ] Polished menus
- [ ] Hundreds of levels
- [ ] Complex economy
- [ ] Production advertising integration
- [ ] Unused GameFactoryCore managers “for later”

## Core modules allowed this stage

Only if used this sprint (see roadmap):

- GameFlowManager
- AnalyticsManager (editor sink)
- LevelManager (if more than one level)
